# TrustedTechLeader

> Founder-led marketing fulfillment partner for US small businesses: social media posts and short videos for Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, Meta and Google Search ads, CRM setup and management (GoHighLevel or HubSpot), and lead follow-up automations. Fixed monthly prices. Run by Abdul Rahman.

## Pages

- [Home](https://trustedtechleader.com/): What I do, why one partner, how it works, and pricing.
- [Services and pricing](https://trustedtechleader.com/services/): Monthly plans, starter projects, what is not included, and FAQ.
- [Sample projects](https://trustedtechleader.com/work/): Two fictional demonstrations, not client work. No results are claimed.
- [About](https://trustedtechleader.com/about/): Who I am and how I work.
- [Contact](https://trustedtechleader.com/contact/): Book a 20-minute call.
- [Privacy policy](https://trustedtechleader.com/privacy/)
- [Terms of service](https://trustedtechleader.com/terms/)

## Key facts

- Services: social content, paid ads (Meta and Google Search), CRM setup and management, automation.
- Videos are edited from short phone clips the client films, or made from stock footage, AI tools, motion graphics and voiceover. No on-location filming or photo shoots.
- Not included: website builds, on-location filming or photo shoots, TikTok ads, PR or influencer campaigns, custom software.
- First deliverables within 7 days of kickoff.
- Contact: abdul@trustedtechleader.com
